notes: ACCESS: next.co.uk is Akamai-protected. Unlike the prior Home-Decor pass (which needed translate.goog), a direct curl_cffi fetch with impersonate='safari17_0' returned genuine origin HTML on every /shop/... path on this run (first profile tried; HTTP 200 on all ~90 URLs fetched). WebFetch and r.jina.ai still 403, and a real Chrome tab on the wardrobes URL rendered only the Akamai interstitial - so no rendered listing header is obtainable by any route. QTY SOURCE: every qty is the SSR-embedded search state field "search":{"totalResults":N} on that exact leaf URL (brief method 2, used because method 1 is unobtainable). Cross-validated three ways: (a) the department page's own left-nav link/category facet blob independently reports the same per-child counts; (b) leaf counts reconcile with their department totals (bathroom-furniture 60+6+3+1+11-excluded-storage = 81 = department total 81; kids furniture 144+51+47+40+12+6+4+4+1 = 309 = department total 309); (c) every leaf was fetched TWICE with cache bypassed and all 46 totals were identical on both reads. Bad-slug discrimination check: /shop/home/furniture/zzz-not-a-real-slug returns h1 'Sorry, the category you requested might have moved or no longer exists.' with totalResults 0 rather than silently serving the parent, so every emitted URL was h1-verified. TREE SOURCE: the site's own Furniture landing page https://www.next.co.uk/furniture carries the full furniture navigation (All Sofas / Living Room / Dining Room / Bedroom / Bathroom Furniture / Home Office / Kids and Nursery / Garden), which is what the row tree follows; cross-checked against the link-facet blob and the chip carousel on /shop/home/furniture. ROOM-PREFIX TRAP (confirmed and handled): on Next the room segment in /shop/home/furniture/<room>/<type> is sometimes cosmetic and sometimes not - living-room-furniture/chests (541) == bedroom-furniture/chests (541) == the global chests node, and living-room-furniture/sideboards (532) == dining-room-furniture/sideboards (532); but bedroom-furniture/side-table (129) != living-room-furniture/side-table (582), and home-office/shelves (140) != storage-organisation/shelves (260). Pages whose h1 is a generated 'Home <X>' fallback are the alias copies; pages with a real SEO h1 ('Side Tables', 'Desks', 'Shelves & Shelving Units') are canonical. Each type is therefore emitted ONCE, at the URL the site's own nav links to. Deduped this way: Sideboards (nav shows it under both Living Room and Dining Room -> kept once under Dining Room), Shelves & Bookcases (shown under Living Room, Home Office and Storage -> kept once as Shelves & Shelving Units under Storage & Organisation), Drinks Cabinets (Dining Room + Storage -> kept once under Storage). Also confirmed that bare /shop/home/nursery is an alias page serving the entire Home catalogue as facets (24794 results; lists 'wallpaper', 'rugs', 'ceiling lights' as children) and is NOT the real Nursery department - only /shop/home/nursery/nursery-furniture was used. EXCLUDED (inspected, not skipped on name): Mattresses at every level (bedroom 311, childrens 40, nursery 78) - bedding per brief; Fireplaces 130 under Living Room Furniture (h1 'Electric Fires and Surrounds'; title-checked: fire surrounds plus Dimplex electric media-wall fires = architectural surrounds and heating appliances); Garden Buildings 96 (title-checked: Keter/Rowlinson sheds, gazebos, outdoor storage boxes = structures); Nursery Equipment 83 (title-checked: Joie/Mamas & Papas rockers, swings, playmats = baby equipment); Bathroom Furniture > Storage 11 (title-checked: shower caddies, corner caddy, hairdryer stand = standalone storage accessories); /shop/home/furniture/mirrors 5 (Wall Decor's job); /shop/home/furniture/radiator-cover 2 (radiator screens); /shop/home/furniture/cabinets 187 (fallback-h1 alias page; title-checked and its contents are bathroom/under-sink and mirrored wall cabinets already represented by Bathroom Cabinets 60, and it is not a nav node); /shop/home/furniture/chairsloungers 11, /shop/home/furniture/chairs 2, /shop/home/furniture/living-furniture 3855 and the /shop/home/furniture/storage-organisation parent 288 (mixed roll-up aliases of nodes already emitted); /shop/home/furniture/dining-room-furniture/drink-trolley 1 (title-checked subset of Drinks Cabinets 26); /shop/home/storage-laundry (h1 'Laundry Baskets', no furniture children). Everything outside furniture across Next's Home departments (lighting, mirrors, wall art, textiles, bedding, tableware, home electricals, bathroom fixtures) and the whole of Next's fashion/beauty side were left alone per the brief. NOT EXTRACTED AS ROWS: the sofa sub-nav entries (Accent Chairs, 2/3/4 Seater, Corner, Sofa Beds, Modular, Footstools, Leather Sofas) are /f/ facet-filter URLs on the Sofas node rather than category paths and they overlap each other, so Sofas & Chairs is emitted as a single leaf with its own exact total and their counts are recorded in that row's flag as the explanation for its size. Brand, colour, material, price, 'story-' and feat-newin facet URLs were skipped.
